brief.meaningEn: Unable to change familiar ways of acting even when they no longer serve a purpose.
brief.meaningZh: 即使舊做法已不合用，仍難以擺脫熟悉的行事方式。
brief.grammar: be/become/get trapped in old habits; trapped is a participle, habits is plural.
brief.register: Neutral reflective language. A team leader might say it to colleagues when reviewing an outdated workflow.
brief.boundaryZh: 強調舊習慣反覆限制改變，不是單次使用舊方法，也不表示人真的被困在某處。
brief.misconceptionZh: 沿用經證明仍有效的做法，不必然是受舊習慣困住。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出反覆舊做法如何阻礙改進。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 96, row 2; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: A team can become trapped in old habits.

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent reviews remain pending.

listening.promptZh: 團隊為何錯過新客戶的提問？

options.en: It kept sending a monthly report and ignored the newer daily message channel.
options.zh: 團隊只按舊習慣寄月報，忽略新的每日訊息渠道。

options.en: It changed its communication routine after the first missed message.
options.zh: 團隊第一次漏訊後便改變溝通方法。

options.en: The customer used an address that no team member knew existed.
options.zh: 客戶使用了一個團隊無人知道的地址。

options.en: The team tested both channels each morning.
options.zh: 團隊每天早上測試兩種渠道。

listening.explanationZh: 團隊明知每日渠道已啟用，仍反覆依賴舊月報，因而失去回應機會。
listening.en: We still send the old monthly report even though clients now ask questions in the daily channel. We are trapped in old habits, and we missed a new customer’s request yesterday.
listening.zh: 即使客戶現在透過每日渠道提問，我們仍寄舊式月報。我們受舊習慣困住，昨天錯過了一名新客戶的請求。

reply.promptEn: Clients now write to the daily channel, but our team still relies only on monthly reports. What should we change?
reply.promptZh: （客戶現在使用每日渠道聯絡，但團隊仍只依賴月報。我們應改甚麼？）

options.en: Assign one person to check the daily channel each morning.
options.zh: 安排一人每天早上檢查每日渠道。

options.en: Review which monthly-report details clients still need.
options.zh: 檢討客戶仍需要月報中的哪些內容。

options.en: We are trapped in old habits; let us test a daily response routine.
options.zh: 我們受舊習慣困住；試行每日回覆流程吧。

options.en: Tell clients which channel will receive the quickest answer.
options.zh: 告訴客戶哪個渠道能最快得到回覆。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都是適當的改善方法；金句指出反覆沿用不合用的舊流程。

scene.promptZh: 診所已改用網上預約，但接待處仍只在紙簿上查時段，反覆漏看病人提交的網上預約。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The reception team is trapped in old habits despite the new booking system.
options.zh: 即使有新預約系統，接待團隊仍受舊習慣困住。

options.en: The team is using both booking systems accurately during a planned transition.
options.zh: 團隊在計劃中的過渡期準確使用兩個系統。

options.en: The online system has been withdrawn, so the paper book is again required.
options.zh: 網上系統已停用，因此又必須使用紙簿。

scene.explanationZh: 新系統已啟用，卻反覆沿用舊方法而漏預約。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況只是保留有效做法，不足以說 trapped in old habits？

options.en: The kitchen keeps a proven safety checklist while updating the rest of its routine.
options.zh: 廚房保留已證實有效的安全清單，同時更新其他流程。

options.en: A group keeps printing forms no one uses despite repeated complaints.
options.zh: 一組人即使屢遭投訴，仍反覆印沒人使用的表格。

options.en: The team ignores the new booking portal and repeatedly loses requests.
options.zh: 團隊不理會新預約平台，反覆遺失要求。

contrast.explanationZh: 保留有效安全做法並更新其他流程，並非被不合用的習慣束縛。

dialogue.promptZh: （甲：義工仍把每項要求放進舊抽屜，但大家現在都看新的網上清單。乙：______）

options.en: We are trapped in old habits; let us move new requests to the shared list.
options.zh: 我們受舊習慣困住；把新要求轉到共用清單吧。

options.en: We should check whether the drawer is clearly labelled before moving anything.
options.zh: 轉移資料前，我們應檢查抽屜標籤是否清楚。

options.en: We could keep a paper backup while updating the shared list.
options.zh: 更新共用清單時，可以保留紙本備份。

dialogue.explanationZh: 習慣性使用無人查閱的抽屜，阻礙有效處理新要求。
dialogue.promptEn: A: Our volunteers still file every request in the old drawer, even though the new online list is where everyone looks. B: ______

speaking.en: The library was trapped in old habits, so it kept mailing notices after most members had chosen email updates.
speaking.zh: 圖書館受舊習慣困住，因此大多數會員已選擇電郵通知後，仍繼續寄出紙本通知。
speaking.promptZh: 說出反覆舊做法及為何它已不合用。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：團隊有較適用的新工具，但仍反覆沿用舊方法，造成漏訊或延誤。用英文交代新舊做法及後果。
writing.selfCheckZh: 必須顯示舊做法已不合用，而且反覆阻礙改進；不要把有效的安全慣例誤寫成問題。

examples.en: The theatre team was trapped in old habits: it posted rehearsal changes on a wall board even after performers began checking a shared calendar, so several missed an updated rehearsal time.
examples.zh: 劇團受舊習慣困住：演員已開始查看共用日曆，它仍把綵排變動貼在告示板上，結果有幾名演員錯過更新後的綵排時間。

examples.en: Although the farm installed a new water monitor, the crew remained trapped in old habits and recorded readings only once a week, so leaks were noticed too late.
examples.zh: 雖然農場裝了新的水量監測器，團隊仍受舊習慣困住，只每週記錄一次讀數，因此漏水問題發現得太遲。

takeaways.en: A team is trapped in old habits when it repeats a method that no longer works.
takeaways.zh: 團隊反覆使用不再奏效的方法時，便可說受舊習慣困住。

takeaways.en: They remained trapped in old habits until they tested the new booking system.
takeaways.zh: 他們試用新預約系統前，一直受舊習慣困住。
